1. Log-in to your [container](https://cmgr.oit.duke.edu/containers);
2. Double-check that you have the `sta101-f26-files` project loaded in the upper-right corner of RStudio (this should always be true);
2. Go to the "Git" tab in the upper-right panel of RStudio and click the **Pull** button (arrow pointing down). Now the new assignment template and dataset should appear in the `lab` folder of your **Files**.
